scope: Historical initial review of isolated pure M CPU/global retained-staging primitive; source was subsequently fixed before this initial report could be published. No real R lock/PID/GPU operation or production permit.

findings.title: Fork-child context exit unlocks parent CPU slot
findings.impact: The inherited cache._lock context issues LOCK_UN on the shared open-file description, so another slot0 job can enter while the parent context is still active.
findings.probe: Parent enter; fork child unwinds inherited context and exits0; independent slot0 acquired before parent exit.
findings.fix: Use process-aware close-only inherited descriptor semantics on the same shared CPU slot path; ensure no descendant finalizer issues parent LOCK_UN.

findings.title: Preconstructed pool entered after fork creates a wrong-owner claim
findings.impact: Child enter publishes its still-live parent PID/start; child cannot release, parent copy has claim_path=None, and the dead child quota remains charged as an active parent reservation.
findings.probe: Parent-constructed pool entered in child; record.pid==parent; child release raised; child reaped; next otherwise-fitting reservation still denied.
findings.fix: Verify constructor PID/start before entering/publishing, preserving child-cannot-release-parent semantics.

findings.title: Unreaped zombies retain unused live reservations
findings.impact: Start ticks persist after exit, so a zombie is classified alive and blocks unused capacity reclamation until an unrelated waitpid.
findings.probe: Exited8MiB claimant held as zombie in12MiB pool; live=True, another8MiB denied; same request passed immediately after reap.
findings.fix: Read state/birth coherently and exclude zombie/dead states; continue charging actual residual staging.

findings.title: Dangling .staging symlink is silently admitted
findings.impact: Glob/existence handling treats the foreign dangling stage as zero/absent and admits a reservation. No overwrite/escape was observed.
findings.probe: Canonical output .staging->absent target admitted successfully; symlink preserved.
findings.fix: Explicitly inspect/reject staging symlinks before existence checks, including dangling links.

test_boundary: Initial8tests pass but omit the four reproduced paths. Existing CPU fork test uses os._exit rather than unwinding; death test waitpid-reaps before recovery.
harness_note: Initial extra-probe SSH system Python lacked torch and stopped before any fork probe; successful probes used project Python -B with bytecode disabled. No implementation/test source was edited.
integration_boundaries: All writers must honor reserved staging quota and lifetime; orphan writers must not outlive claim owners.
Append-only release ownership is enforced through trusted API/process checks, not authentication against an unrestricted same-UID direct JSON forger.
Actual M entry, production CPU/resource admission, models/targets/GPU owner and scientific output are separate unreviewed gates.
